svg.title: CloudBSD Admin — vGPU Pool (expanded, 12 GPUs across 3 nodes)
svg.desc: GPU resource tracking shown only when showVgpuResources flag is on. 12 physical GPUs across 3 nodes (4 per node): 5× T4, 4× A4000, 2× A5000, 1× A6000, 1× A100-MIG. 22 vGPU allocations: whole-gpu, slices (1/2, 1/3, 1/4), MIG instances.

div.div: 12 physical GPUs · 3 nodes · 304 GB total VRAM · 22 vGPU allocations · MOCK feature-flag-gated
